groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Cautiously Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.600% and the 10Y at 4.931%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 4 consecutive sessions. QQQ is +0.06% over five sessions and -1.03% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +0.00% at about $114.88, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-18/100, 63% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum on the supportive side versus rising volatility as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.

paragraphs: QQQ is -1.42% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -18/100 (Cautiously Negative). Score path: pre-market +1 → now -18; open -35 → now -18 (improved 17 points).

The main live drivers are Rates are mixed: the 10Y is 4.931%, -4.3 bp since the opening snapshot. The 2Y rate signal is mixed: 4.600% (-5.6 bp vs prev close). Semiconductors are mixed: Previous regular-session close · SOX -1.42% | Nasdaq -1.38% | SOX vs Nasdaq -0.04 pp | SOXX vs Nasdaq -0.17 pp | SMH vs Nasdaq +0.32 pp. It changed from negative to mixed after the baseline snapshot.
QQQ and its internal leadership are diverging, so the index move has weaker confirmation (semiconductors mixed, mega-caps negative, breadth mixed).

What would change the view: improvement would require semiconductors regaining leadership versus QQQ, broader participation, VXN/VIX cooling. Deterioration would be reinforced by a reversal in the 10Y back above roughly 5.00–5.05%.
